## Required contributor checks

- [ ] Read root/scoped AGENTS.md, assigned task, execution contract and applicable UI/agent contracts.
- [ ] Changes stay within the task; any agreed boundary change is documented.
- [ ] Acceptance ticks have evidence; no historical/fixture result is labeled as a new Windows/browser/database pass.
- [ ] Shared shell, authorization, data ownership and scan-only scope are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets or unintended generated files; diff checks pass.
- [ ] Task status is accurate; DONE is reserved for integrated and accepted work.
